slides.teacher_cue: New sound. Upper front teeth rest lightly on the lower lip. Air flows continuously — a sustained friction. No voicing. Lips do not close. Hold your hand near your mouth: /p/ — one burst. /f/ — continuous airstream. Tactile session mandatory.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /f/ cleanly as a voiceless labiodental fricative with continuous airflow.
slides.correction_move: Tactile feedback: students hold hand near mouth. /p/ — one burst felt. /f/ — continuous stream felt. Alternate p-f-p-f until students feel and hear the difference.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ substitution — the most common Korean interference error for /f/. Redirect immediately with tactile cue.
